disposition.change: Key owner and team by ID from the events and resolve display names from P3 queue_member and assignment behind the rwb-access masking policy; no personal data travels on an event.

disposition.change: Publish the six baseline measures plus CASES_BY_STAGE, DECISIONS_LOGGED, AGENT_ACCEPTANCE and AGENT_OVERRIDE; carry the count of the seven-measure criteria as an open question.

disposition.change: Declare the measures read in the wave 1 contract for the harness and catalog consumer; keep the dashboard and its data set in RWB-P9-E2009-APP; leave reporting-client connection as an open decision for the PRD step.

disposition.change: Declare the three consumed operations and two owner-queue activities on per-service bases and queues with one hop and 2 s timeout; replay the day's events into a run-scoped read model; hand the published extract to rwb-integration as INT-19 replacement; take agent rates from EV-28 and RWB-P10-E1063-CON.
disposition.note: Consumed operations, workflow names and read-model design belong to the APP and CON stories.
